spans.title: Telling His Father
spans.blurb: A young man leans across the table and tries to tell his father about the woman who makes him hold his breath. His father listens, then reaches over.

spans.title: The Long Walk Uptown
spans.blurb: Down to one pipeful of tobacco and a humiliating offer, a hungry man drinks a neighbor's coffee, dreams over blueprints, then walks uptown into the snow.

spans.title: The Brides of Venice
spans.blurb: Pirates burst into a Venetian wedding and carry off the brides, dowry chests and all. The Doge girds on his sword and the bridegrooms give chase.

spans.title: Them Huggins Boys
spans.blurb: A newcomer to the Sandhills keeps hearing ill of two notorious brothers, and a station agent's tangled warning only deepens the mystery.

spans.title: Married This Afternoon
spans.blurb: She agrees to fly to Callisto with him only after a provisional marriage, and he grins and tells her the paperwork was signed that afternoon.

spans.title: Headache Satellite
spans.blurb: A couple lands on a nightmare moon where an unheard pulse floods their minds, and finds survivors pinned down by something that answers every signal with a blast.

spans.title: The Girl on the Platform
spans.blurb: Coming home after a year away, a traveler steps off the train because his old love beckons from the platform. On the dark road, she is nowhere.

spans.title: The Seal Chaser
spans.blurb: During a circus diving act, an outlandish spectator bolts from his seat to catch the performing seal before she bites somebody, and chases her up to the tank.

spans.title: The Runaway Balloon
spans.blurb: A balloon snaps its cable with eight passengers aboard, and a young circus flier powers up his steel-winged machine to chase it above the clouds.

spans.title: The Challenger's Category
spans.blurb: Sealed in a soundproof force field, an undefeated stamp expert faces a challenger whose chosen category is the planet Mars, with questions no human has seen.
spans.brokenNote: Cuts off mid-sentence during the first round of questions, before the contest turns or resolves anything.

spans.title: The Princess Who Feared Daylight
spans.blurb: A slighted fairy decrees that a wished-for princess must not see daylight before fifteen, so she rides to her lovesick prince in a coach without windows.

spans.title: Three Knocks at Midnight
spans.blurb: A storm howls around a country house at midnight when three loud knocks sound at the door, and a stranger enters dressed, for an instant, in rainbow colors.

spans.title: No Big Elk Boy
spans.blurb: Held as a spy by one prickly cow town, a scrawny stranger fights back the only way he knows: insulting it to its face, at length.
